backend/main.mo: Main backend actor defining course management system types (Course, Note, Test, CurrentAffair, StudentProfile, Video, Logo) with CRUD operations, access control integration, and persistent storage using Maps for all entities.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented admin dashboard features including course/video/test/notes/current affairs management pages with CRUD operations, branding settings, and student management.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend files including admin management pages, public-facing pages, AI learning features, and reusable components with their key functionality.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind directives and custom OKLCH color system variables defining light and dark theme palettes for the educational platform.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the SinghGyanAcademy React application with root div and module script reference.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component configuring TanStack Router with all routes including public pages (home, courses, videos, notes, tests, current affairs, AI zone) and admin pages (dashboard, content management, branding, students).
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Displays an access denied message with a shield icon when users attempt to access administrator-only pages, providing a button to return to the home page.
frontend/src/components/AICurrentAffairs: AI-powered current affairs generator component with date picker that generates mock news summaries across categories (Education, Economy, Environment, International Relations, Science) and related quiz questions.
frontend/src/components/AIExamStrategyAd: Provides AI-generated exam preparation strategies including study plans, recommended books, and timetables for various competitive exams (UPSC, SSC, Railway, Banking, etc.). Users select an exam type and optionally ask questions to receive detailed, phase-wise preparation guidance.
frontend/src/components/AIFeaturesShowca: Displays a grid of six AI-powered learning features (AI Teacher, Notes Generator, Test Generator, Exam Strategy, Geography Expert, Current Affairs) as clickable cards that navigate to the AI learning zone.
frontend/src/components/AIGeographyExper: Generates specialized geography content with concept explanations, key features, visual descriptions, and related topics. Supports both competitive exam level and university level content across various geography categories.
frontend/src/components/AINotesGenerator: Creates comprehensive study notes for different subjects (History, Geography, Polity, Economy, Science, Current Affairs) with structured content and revision points tailored for competitive exam preparation.
frontend/src/components/AITeacherChat.ts: Implements a chat interface where users can ask questions about various subjects and receive AI-generated responses with study guidance, exam tips, and topic explanations in both English and Hindi.
Generates custom MCQ tests with configurable question counts and topics for different test types (daily quiz, weekly test, full-length mock test), including questions with multiple-choice options and explanations.
frontend/src/components/CourseCard.tsx: Displays a clickable card for a course category showing its icon, name, course count, and a button to view details. Maps CourseCategory enum values to human-readable labels.
frontend/src/components/CurrentAffairIte: Renders a card for a current affairs item with its content and an optional downloadable PDF file. Shows the item ID and provides a download button when a file is attached.
frontend/src/components/FileUploadWithPr: Provides a file upload component with progress tracking that converts selected files to ExternalBlob format. Displays upload percentage and allows clearing the selected file.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with three columns: academy description, quick navigation links, and social media icons (YouTube, WhatsApp). Includes copyright notice and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper component that structures the app with Navigation at top, Outlet for page content in the middle, and Footer at bottom. Uses flex column to ensure footer stays at bottom.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Provides login/logout button using Internet Identity authentication. Handles login state, shows loading spinner during authentication, and clears query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Main navigation header with logo, navigation links (including AI Learning Zone), mobile menu toggle, and login button. Fetches and displays custom logo if available, shows admin link for admin users.
frontend/src/components/NotesList.tsx: Displays a grid of note cards for a specific subject with download buttons. Shows empty state message when no notes are available for the selected subject.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Modal dialog that prompts authenticated users without profiles to enter their name and email. Saves profile and registers student, preventing dismissal until completed.
frontend/src/components/TestCard.tsx: Displays a test card showing assessment type, test ID, and question count with a button to start the test. Maps AssessmentType enum to readable labels.
frontend/src/components/YouTubeEmbed.tsx: Responsive YouTube video embed component using 16:9 aspect ratio. Takes videoId and optional title props to render an iframe with standard YouTube embed settings.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on authentication state. Initializes access control with admin token and invalidates dependent queries when actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React hook and provider for Internet Identity authentication on ICP, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for all backend data operations including user profiles, courses, subjects, notes, tests, videos, current affairs, and admin functions with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a comprehensive design system including light/dark themes, color schemes, and sidebar styling.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutUs.tsx: About page describing SinghGyan Academy's mission to provide free competitive exam education, featuring sections on vision, offerings, and founder information with icon-based layout.
frontend/src/pages/admin/BrandingSetting: Admin page for uploading and managing the platform logo, with file preview and save functionality restricted to admin users.
frontend/src/pages/admin/Dashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard displaying overview cards with counts for courses, videos, notes, tests, current affairs, and students, with navigation to management pages.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ManageCourses.t: Admin interface for creating, editing, and deleting courses with category selection, syllabus, video lectures, notes/PYQ file uploads, and test series management.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ManageCurrentAf: Admin page for managing current affairs entries (daily updates, weekly PDFs, monthly magazines) with content editing, file uploads, and filtering by type.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ManageNotes.tsx: Admin page for managing study notes with CRUD operations, file uploads, and organization by subject (History, Geography, Polity, etc.). Includes tabbed interface for viewing notes by subject and confirmation dialogs for deletions.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ManageTests.tsx: Admin page for managing assessments (Daily Quiz, Weekly Test, Full Length Test) with CRUD operations for test questions. Features dynamic question input fields, tabbed interface by assessment type, and delete confirmation dialogs.
frontend/src/pages/admin/ManageVideos.ts: Admin page for managing video content with CRUD operations for YouTube links organized by categories (Geography Classes, Current Affairs, etc.). Includes search functionality and YouTube embed preview.
frontend/src/pages/admin/StudentManageme: Admin page displaying all registered students in a paginated table with search functionality and CSV export capability. Shows student ID, name, email, and enrolled course count.
frontend/src/pages/AILearningZone.tsx: AI Learning Zone page with tabbed interface for six AI-powered tools: teacher chat, notes generator, test generator, exam strategy advisor, geography expert, and current affairs generator.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page displaying phone, email, WhatsApp community link, and office address in a card-based layout with call-to-action buttons.
frontend/src/pages/CourseDetail.tsx: Displays detailed course information for a specific exam category with tabs for syllabus, videos, notes, PYQ, and tests. Fetches course data by category and renders YouTube embeds, downloadable resources, and structured content sections.
frontend/src/pages/Courses.tsx: Lists all available course categories (UPSC, SSC, Railway, etc.) in a grid layout with course counts. Fetches sorted courses and displays them using CourseCard components.
frontend/src/pages/CurrentAffairs.tsx: Displays current affairs content organized in tabs for daily updates, weekly PDFs, and monthly magazines. Fetches and renders CurrentAffairItem components for each type.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page featuring hero section, AI features showcase, course categories, latest current affairs, and social media links. Aggregates course counts and displays promotional content with navigation to various sections.
frontend/src/pages/Notes.tsx: Organizes study notes by subject (History, Geography, Polity, Economy, Science, Current Affairs) in a tabbed interface. Fetches notes for each subject and displays them using NotesList component.
frontend/src/pages/TakeTest.tsx: Interactive test-taking interface with question navigation, answer selection, progress tracking, and results display. Requires Internet Identity authentication and manages test state including current question, answers, and submission.
frontend/src/pages/TestSeries.tsx: Displays a tabbed interface for browsing test series (daily quizzes, weekly tests, full-length tests) with cards for each assessment type fetched via hooks.
frontend/src/pages/VideoClasses.tsx: Renders a tabbed video classes page organized by category (geography, current affairs, GS, strategy) with YouTube embeds for available lectures.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting and persisting URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for maintaining state across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom color scheme using OKLCH color space, extended theme settings for UI components (sidebar, card, chart), and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state file defining an AI-powered online education platform for competitive exam preparation with 8 main sections including courses, video classes, notes, test series, current affairs, and AI-powered features (AI Teacher, Notes Generator, Test Generator, Geography Expert, Exam Strategy Advisor). Tracks 11 existing features and architectural notes for multi-page website with YouTube embedding, PDF downloads, Google Forms integration, WhatsApp integration, and student registration system.
